statement.document_title: Dear Elon Musk, here are five things you might want to consider about AGI

from_speaker: AI will not be able to watch a movie
tell you accurately what is going on
What are their conflicts and motivations?
our_interpretation: Read this as a forecast about general movie comprehension, including events, characters, conflicts and inferred motivations.
A suitable test uses varied full movies and open-ended explanations, with controls against answering from memorized summaries. A hand-picked clip or isolated correct answer is insufficient.
Accuracy means ordinary competent comprehension, allowing reasonable differences in interpretation; it does not require perfect recall of every detail.
Use 2029-12-31 as the latest deadline. An earlier reproducible demonstration of the complete capability can refute the forecast under the early-resolution rule.
Assess this individual forecast independently of the surrounding wager about passing three challenges.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence covering the end of 2029 shows that leading available systems still cannot accurately explain full movies across a representative evaluation of events, characters, conflicts and motivations.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one AI system demonstrates accurate full-movie comprehension across varied movies under a credible evaluation that tests the stated narrative elements.

evidence.explanation: The study reports persistent difficulties in narrative understanding and improvements when relevant visual content is selected. It does not establish the complete capability required for early contradiction, and its results cannot settle performance in 2029.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A reproducible full-movie evaluation meeting the early-resolution rule would contradict the forecast. Otherwise, evaluate available systems through 2029 using a disclosed rubric covering events, characters, conflicts and motivations.
